#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 5005;
const int INF = 1000000007;
const int TIME = 100;
using CostType = int;

struct Arc {
    int from, to;
    CostType cap, flow, cost;
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    int n, m, S, T;
    vector<int> adj[MAXN];
    vector<Arc> edges;
    CostType dist[MAXN];
    bool inQueue[MAXN];
    int prev[MAXN];
    CostType possible[MAXN];

    MinCostFlow(int nodeCount) : n(nodeCount) {}

    void addEdge(int from, int to, CostType cap, CostType cost) {
        edges.push_back({from, to, cap, 0, cost});
        edges.push_back({to, from, 0, 0, -cost});
        m = (int)edges.size();
        adj[from].push_back(m - 2);
        adj[to].push_back(m - 1);
    }

    bool shortestPath(CostType &augFlow, CostType &pathCost) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) dist[i] = INF;
        fill(inQueue, inQueue + n, false);

        dist[S] = 0;
        inQueue[S] = true;
        prev[S] = -1;
        possible[S] = INF;

        queue<int> q;
        q.push(S);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inQueue[u] = false;

            for (int id : adj[u]) {
                Arc &e = edges[id];
                if (e.cap > e.flow && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    prev[e.to] = id;
                    possible[e.to] = min(possible[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                    if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                        q.push(e.to);
                        inQueue[e.to] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[T] == INF) return false;

        augFlow = possible[T];
        pathCost = dist[T];

        for (int v = T; v != S; v = edges[prev[v]].from) {
            edges[prev[v]].flow += possible[T];
            edges[prev[v] ^ 1].flow -= possible[T];
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<CostType, CostType> minCost(int s, int t) {
        S = s;
        T = t;
        CostType totalCost = 0;
        CostType totalFlow = 0;
        CostType f = 0, c = 0;

        while (shortestPath(f, c)) {
            totalFlow += f;
            totalCost += f * c;
        }
        return {totalFlow, totalCost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, C, D;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> C >> D;

    MinCostFlow solver(n * TIME + 2);
    int src = n * TIME;
    int snk = src + 1;

    for (int t = 0; t < TIME; ++t) {
        solver.addEdge(t, snk, k, C * t);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        solver.addEdge(src, x * TIME, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int city = 0; city < n; ++city) {
        for (int t = 1; t < TIME; ++t) {
            solver.addEdge(city * TIME + t - 1, city * TIME + t, k, 0);
        }
    }

    while (m--) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        --u; --v;

        for (int t = 1; t < TIME; ++t) {
            int a = u * TIME + t - 1, b = v * TIME + t;
            int c = v * TIME + t - 1, d = u * TIME + t;

            for (int i = 1, cost = D; i <= k; ++i, cost += 2 * D) {
                solver.addEdge(a, b, 1, cost);
                solver.addEdge(c, d, 1, cost);
            }
        }
    }

    auto ans = solver.minCost(src, snk);
    cout << ans.second << '\n';
    return 0;
}

const int MAXN = 5005;

const int K = 100;

};

struct MinCostFlow {
    int n;
    vector<Edge> G[MAXN];
    int dist[MAXN], pv[MAXN], pe[MAXN];
    bool inq[MAXN];

    MinCostFlow(int n) : n(n) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        int usz = G[u].size();
        int vsz = G[v].size();
        G[u].push_back({v, vsz, cap, cost});
        G[v].push_back({u, usz, 0, -cost});
    }

    pair<int,int> minCost(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            fill(dist, dist + n, INF);
            fill(inq, inq + n, false);
            dist[s] = 0;
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(s);
            inq[s] = true;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                inq[u] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)G[u].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge &e = G[u][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        pv[e.to] = u;
                        pe[e.to] = i;
                        if (!inq[e.to]) {

                            inq[e.to] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }

            if (dist[t] == INF) break;

            int add = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = pv[v]) {
                add = min(add, G[pv[v]][pe[v]].cap);
            }
            flow += add;
            cost += add * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = pv[v]) {
                Edge &e = G[pv[v]][pe[v]];
                e.cap -= add;
                G[v][e.rev].cap += add;
            }
        }
        return {flow, cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, C, D;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> C >> D;

    MinCostFlow mcf(n * K + 2);
    int src = n * K;
    int sink = src + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i)
        mcf.addEdge(i, sink, k, C * i);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        mcf.addEdge(src, x * K, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j)
            mcf.addEdge(i * K + j - 1, i * K + j, k, 0);

    while (m--) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        --u; --v;

        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
            int a = u * K + j - 1, b = v * K + j;
            int c = v * K + j - 1, d = u * K + j;

            for (int i = 1, cc = D; i <= k; ++i, cc += 2 * D) {
                mcf.addEdge(a, b, 1, cc);
                mcf.addEdge(c, d, 1, cc);
            }
        }
    }

    auto res = mcf.minCost(src, sink);
    cout << res.second << '\n';

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 5005;
const int INF = 1000000007;
const int K = 100;

struct Edge {
    int u, v, cap, flow, cost;
};

struct MCF {
    int n, m, s, t;
    vector<int> adj[MAXN];
    vector<Edge> edges;
    int dist[MAXN];
    int parent[MAXN];
    int bottleneck[MAXN];
    bool inStack[MAXN];

    MCF(int n) : n(n) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        edges.push_back({u, v, cap, 0, cost});
        edges.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -cost});
        m = (int)edges.size();
        adj[u].push_back(m - 2);
        adj[v].push_back(m - 1);
    }

    bool findPath(int &addFlow, int &pathCost) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) dist[i] = INF;
        fill(inStack, inStack + n, false);
        fill(parent, parent + n, -1);
        dist[s] = 0;
        parent[s] = -1;
        bottleneck[s] = INF;

        vector<int> st;
        st.push_back(s);
        inStack[s] = true;

        while (!st.empty()) {
            int u = st.back();
            st.pop_back();
            inStack[u] = false;

            for (int i = 0; i < (int)adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge &e = edges[adj[u][i]];
                if (e.cap > e.flow && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                    dist[e.v] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    parent[e.v] = adj[u][i];
                    bottleneck[e.v] = min(bottleneck[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                    if (!inStack[e.v]) {
                        st.push_back(e.v);
                        inStack[e.v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[t] == INF) return false;
        addFlow = bottleneck[t];
        pathCost = dist[t];

        for (int v = t; v != s; v = edges[parent[v]].u) {
            edges[parent[v]].flow += bottleneck[t];
            edges[parent[v] ^ 1].flow -= bottleneck[t];
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<int,int> minCost(int s, int t) {
        this->s = s;
        this->t = t;
        int totalCost = 0;
        int totalFlow = 0;
        int f, c;
        while (findPath(f, c)) {
            totalFlow += f;
            totalCost += f * c;

        return {totalFlow, totalCost};

            for (int i = 1, cc = D; i <= k; ++i, cc += 2 * D) {
